title: A model, reasoning, hands and a loop
sub: The third film of What an agent is, a series on what an AI agent is and what it isn't: a model that writes, reasoning that checks its plan against rules, hands that read, and a loop that keeps going until the checks pass; and where the steps are known, a plain script that does the job better.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model, orange the data coming back, green a check that passes, amber one that fails, or a loop. The scenes of 1914 are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
